row: We are an official 501(c)(3) non-profit organization dedicated to saving euthanasia listed dogs in California, Colorado and Florida by placing them in foster homes, and/or adoption homes and giving them necessary medical help if needed. Bringing awareness to our communities about the crisis of shelter pets that have been abandoned or surrendered.
